method: Bounded source-only study of eight remaining annotated WIS lower-vowel sites. Native embedded original A2 pixels and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements only. Prior reports remain immutable; source-row wording is clarified and a mistaken scratch bare label is expressly excluded below.

decisions.finding: The complete lamed foot is followed by a broad shallow continuous plateau with a flat lower edge apart from a one-pixel right end lug, connected to the foot through a narrow left neck. The literal same-page detached lamed-patah in5:21 has the same contour. Those competing features are absent here. Certify patah from the surviving contour alone.
